Built for physical design.

      
It reads every run, finds why a block is failing, patches the flow and reruns. What worked carries over to the next block, on one die or across a stack.

    

  


  

    

      RTL ▸ SYNTHESIS ▸ FLOORPLAN ▸ PLACEMENT ▸ CTS ▸ ROUTING ▸ TIMING ▸ DRC ▸ SIGNOFF ▸ 3D STACKING ▸
      RTL ▸ SYNTHESIS ▸ FLOORPLAN ▸ PLACEMENT ▸ CTS ▸ ROUTING ▸ TIMING ▸ DRC ▸ SIGNOFF ▸ 3D STACKING ▸
    

  


  

    

      
Chips went to 3D,
 EDA should too

      
Logic, memory and I/O now ship as stacked dies. Most tools still treat each die as a flat chip, so the stack is closed by hand.

      

        
Partitioning
Which blocks go on which die, and what every crossing costs.

        
Cross-die timing
Paths that start on one tier and end on another.

        
Heat and power
A hot logic die under memory changes what will close.

        
Bonds and TSVs
The interface between dies is now part of the floorplan.

      

      
We’re building Archgen to work on the whole stack as one design.
